headline: KwaiMind reports CTR-guided image editing gains in an online product-image test
summary: Kuaishou’s KwaiMind paper combines an e-commerce image editor, an 11-task benchmark and rewards for commercial click-through rate (CTR), text accuracy and product consistency. The authors report an online A/B test in which CTR-based selection of product images increased observed CTR by about 2.44% relative to a control. In a separate offline test, the share of generated images whose predicted CTR exceeded the original image rose from 12.16% to 37.41%; this compares each checkpoint with original images, not with each other. The public code repository exposes benchmark data and evaluation commands, but the online test’s sample size and uncertainty are not reported in the inspected passage and the result has not been independently reproduced.
